title: datura alba
intro: Datura alba, commonly known as Devil's Trumpet or Angels Trumpet, is a plant species that belongs to the Solanaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include relief from anxiety, insomnia, and other nervous system disorders, due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Datura alba are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as scopolamine and hyoscyamine, which exhibit anticholinergic and sedative effects. However, it is essential to note that the plant contains toxic compounds and should be used under the guidance of a medical professional.
